description: This file implements the Graph Control's Grapher class, managing graph rendering, user interactions, and graph state updates in a Windows UWP application. It includes methods for zooming, panning, resetting the grid, handling input events, and managing graph equations and options.

classes.name: Grapher
classes.description: Main class managing graph rendering, user interaction, and graph state in a UWP application.

methods.name: Grapher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Grapher, setting up event handlers and default properties.

methods.name: ZoomFromCenter
methods.description: Zooms the graph centered at the current view by a specified scale factor.

methods.name: ScaleRange
methods.description: Scales the graph view around a specified center point by a given scale factor.

methods.name: ResetGrid
methods.description: Resets the graph grid to initial or default ranges.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Handles template application, initializes rendering components.

methods.name: OnEquationsPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the equations collection, updates event subscriptions.

methods.name: OnEquationChanged
methods.description: Handles individual equation change events, triggers re-plotting.

methods.name: OnEquationStyleChanged
methods.description: Handles style changes in equations, updates graph options.

methods.name: OnEquationLineEnabledChanged
methods.description: Handles toggling of equation line visibility, triggers re-plot.

methods.name: AnalyzeEquation
methods.description: Performs analysis on a given equation to extract features or errors.

methods.name: PlotGraph
methods.description: Initiates plotting of equations, with option to keep current view.

methods.name: TryPlotGraph
methods.description: Attempts to plot the graph asynchronously, handling errors and retries.

methods.name: TryUpdateGraph
methods.description: Updates the graph with current equations and variables asynchronously.

methods.name: SetEquationsAsValid
methods.description: Marks all graphable equations as validated.

methods.name: SetEquationErrors
methods.description: Flags equations with errors after a failed plot attempt.

methods.name: SetGraphArgs
methods.description: Sets variable arguments for the graph.

methods.name: GetGraph
methods.description: Creates and returns a graph object for a specific equation.

methods.name: UpdateVariables
methods.description: Updates the variable list based on current graph variables.

methods.name: SetVariable
methods.description: Sets a variable's value and updates the graph accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateGraphOptions
methods.description: Updates graph options based on equations and user settings.

methods.name: GetGraphableEquations
methods.description: Returns a list of equations suitable for graphing.

methods.name: OnForceProportionalAxesPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the force proportional axes property.

methods.name: OnUseCommaDecimalSeperatorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to decimal separator localization.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer entering the control area.

methods.name: UpdateTracingChanged
methods.description: Updates tracing state and events.

methods.name: OnPointerMoved
methods.description: Handles pointer movement events for panning and tracing.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exit events, resets cursor and tracing.

methods.name: OnPointerWheelChanged
methods.description: Handles mouse wheel events for zooming.

methods.name: OnPointerPressed
methods.description: Handles pointer press events, captures pointer.

methods.name: OnPointerReleased
methods.description: Handles pointer release events, releases pointer capture.

methods.name: OnPointerCanceled
methods.description: Handles pointer cancel events, releases pointer capture.

methods.name: OnManipulationDelta
methods.description: Handles manipulation events for panning and zooming gestures.

methods.name: GetGraphBitmapStream
methods.description: Returns a stream with the current graph image.

methods.name: ConvertToLinear
methods.description: Converts MathML string to linear format.

methods.name: FormatMathML
methods.description: Formats MathML string for display.

methods.name: OnAxesColorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to axes color property.

methods.name: OnGraphBackgroundPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to background color property.

methods.name: OnGridLinesColorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to grid lines color property.

methods.name: OnLineWidthPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to line width property.

methods.name: TryInitializeGraph
methods.description: Initializes the graph with optional current view preservation.
